issues.title: Provide explanatory message on Endorse or Request Changes
issues.body:
When the `Release manager` either endorses a document, or requests changes on a document, they are able to provide some notes of explanation. See the two `Review changes` items below:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/130064460-79f959a7-eb61-4879-a773-8697fcc480d6.png)

We need to modify Serge to allow this additional content to be provided.

Suggest these changes:
## Dialog
- produce popup dialog, taking title as parameter
- dialog has text-area for explanation to be provided
- dialog has `Cancel` and `Send` buttons
- on `Cancel` nothing happens. On `Send` callback is called.

## COA Message Detail - UI
- in `channel-coa-message-detail\index.tsx`
- modify `handleEndors` and `handleRequestChanges` handlers
- popup dialog when handler called
- if dialog cancelled, no further processing
- if dialog `Sent` call existing `requestChanges` or `endors` handlers - passing the new (possibly empty) message to them

##  COA Message Detail - changes
- modify `requestChanges` and `endors` to take a new `FeedbackItem`, to be stored in the message `CollaboraionDetails`. The `feedback` field can be blank if none was provided, but the item should still be created

The above should be tested through the existing `Storybook` for `COA Status Board`
